00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000013.title: Aldous Vale
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000013.synopsis: Mara’s father. A surveyor who drew Bellwether so often that the island started drawing him back. Missing for twelve years.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000013.notes: He is never on the page in the present. Every trace of him should be a map, a pencil or a rule.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000014.title: Ines Vale
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000014.synopsis: Mara’s mother. Left the island with Mara at sixteen and never spoke of it again. Started with the kettle.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000014.notes: Dead before the story starts. Present in Mara’s habits.
